scope: Frozen development experiments; native calibration is limited to query construction at a recording dependency seam.
freeze: Criteria and input hashes fixed before prototype model outputs; no prior result is rewritten.

decision_accounting.unsupported: abstention, never a correct diagnostic rejection
decision_accounting.contract_failure: invalid or missing final schema; never semantic success
decision_accounting.task_failure: provider, timeout or budget failure; separate from judgment

dimensions: decision against independently reviewed fixture label
read grounding: citations cover successful reads and correct immutable revision
rationale adequacy: independent review, never inferred from keyword matches
model requests, tool calls, input/output tokens and elapsed seconds with unknowns retained
native pair sensitivity: exact unchanged control/exploit pair across safe and unsafe fixture sources
planner_scoring: Status and curated anchors are structural checks only. Semantic property fidelity requires independent review; no literal or regex match proves correctness. Preserve identical source/issue/environment inputs and report changed output/schema/skill/model/budget identities.
comparison: Compare each failure category and per-case outcome; do not report aggregate pass rate as semantic accuracy. A rejection with an incorrect rationale is not a correct diagnosis. Unknown telemetry is not zero.
no_leakage: Fixture variant names, expected outcomes and native calibration results stay evaluator-only and are never supplied to author or reviewer; no model-authored code executes on the host.
